text:
emily.cs: Heads-up — our playbook automation is firing duplicate onboarding outreach when Accounts are merged in the CRM. Two customers got triple emails this morning. Repro steps below, looking for a short-term guard.

jamal-csops: Ugh, thanks for flagging. Can you paste an example account canonical id / account ids and the playbook id?

emily.cs: canonical_id: C-0019X, from_account_ids: [A-993, A-994, A-995]
playbook_id: wf_onboard_2023
Query I used to surface the surge:
```
SELECT canonical_id, COUNT(*) as events
FROM outbound_events
WHERE playbook_id = 'wf_onboard_2023' AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY canonical_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```

olivia-sre: Looks like our dedupe is keyed on account_id + email. When merges create new account_ids we lose the dedupe chain. We should debounce on canonical_id or merge_event_id.

jamal-csops: Current schema: outbound_events(store: account_id, email, event_id, merge_flag boolean). The quick patch could be: if merge_flag = true, route to a holding queue (no outbound) for X minutes and let a background job reconcile. Short-term safe.

michael-sales: FYI this bumped a couple renewal outreach threads last week — customers got confused. cc @tara-ops for comms.

tara-ops: Thanks — I can draft a short apology and clarify manual outreach. We also need a backfill plan for anyone who was over-contacted. Recommend pausing the live workflow for 30m while we deploy a patch: `wf_onboard_2023` -> pause.

eng-automation-bot: Created ticket CS-4123: "playbook dedupe: ignore merge-duplicated events" and branch `playbook/debounce-fix`. Assigned to jamal-csops. (tools:jenkins)

jamal-csops: Proposed SQL guard in the playbook trigger:
```
-- allow if not a merge event OR merge older than 30d
WHERE (merge_flag = false) OR (merge_timestamp < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')
```
Also adding `canonical_id` dedupe key to the outbound_events insertion path.

emily.cs: Can we also add a runtime safeguard: skip outbound if for same canonical_id we've sent >1 message in last 24h? That would catch any residual thrash even outside merges.

olivia-sre: :thumbsup: add unit tests for dedupe logic and a small integration test hitting a stub CRM merge event. Tag me in the PR.

tara-ops: I'll prepare the customer-facing note and set a manual pause. Pausing workflow `wf_onboard_2023` for 1h now.

michael-sales: When's the deploy ETA? Need to tell impacted AEs.

eng-automation-bot: Deploy scheduled for 2026-03-21T15:30Z. Will run a canary to monitor >2 outgoing per canonical_id / 1h and rollback on spike.

emily.cs: Added an internal alert (CS-automation) to trigger if >2 outbound emails to same canonical_id within 1h. Also left a note on the customer record for C-0019X.

jamal-csops: I'll open the PR in `playbook/debounce-fix`, include tests, and link CS-4123. Assigning to @eng-automation for rollout verification. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

eng-automation-bot: CS-4123 updated: PR opened (#457) by jamal-csops. Will monitor canary post-deploy.

emily.cs: Closing the thread here — will follow up in CS-4123 for post-deploy verification."
